key_insight: A PDE-consistent deep neural-network closure trained jointly with the LES solver can learn an augmented eddy-viscosity model that better captures heat-release effects and turbulence modulation in premixed jet flames.
engineering_relevance: This offers a more robust LES closure for turbulent combustion, improving prediction of mean fields and resolved turbulence statistics across Damköhler-number regimes.
method: Solver-in-the-loop training with adjoint-based optimization and differentiable programming
Objective functions tested for interpolation and extrapolation across Damköhler numbers
evidence_signal: Compared with the Smagorinsky baseline, the best model reduced a posteriori errors in LES primitive variables by 25-50% and improved resolved Reynolds stress and scalar flux by more than 60%, while remaining stable out of sample.
watch_item: Performance depends on solver-in-the-loop training and careful calibration, so robustness and cost may be concerns when transferring to other flame configurations or flow regimes.
paper_title: Solver-in-the-loop training of deep learning closures for large-eddy simulation of turbulent premixed jet flames
